settings.heading: Sizing
settings.content:
Most bucket hats are a 56–58cm one size. Where several sizes are listed, measure around your head just above the ears and go by that number.

Clothing follows the size chart on the product images. If you are between sizes, go up.

settings.heading: Looking after it
settings.content: Anything cotton takes a cold wash, inside out, hung to dry rather than tumbled. Keep prints out of direct sunlight, and never iron straight over one.

settings.heading: Delivery & returns
settings.content:
Orders go out within two working days. Free UK delivery over £35; international delivery is calculated at checkout.

Thirty days to return anything unworn and in its original packaging.
